name: Fehrer Automotive
old_description: Wir sind einer der weltweit führenden Spezialisten für Komponenten im Fahrzeuginnenraum.
about:
Fehrer Automotive, the U.S. subsidiary of the German Fehrer Group, operates from Gadsden, Alabama, while the group's global headquarters is in Kitzingen, Germany. The company is part of the AUNDE Group, which ranks among the world's top 100 automotive suppliers.

Fehrer develops and manufactures interior components for passenger vehicles, including seat cushions, seat modules, and lightweight composite structures made from fiber-reinforced plastics. The company provides full-service support from concept through series production, employing more than 50 CAD workstations and maintaining on-site service centers at major OEM locations to enable direct engineering collaboration. Prototyping capabilities include CNC milling.

The company serves automotive OEMs and tier-one suppliers worldwide, with a focus on vehicle interior systems. Its composite expertise dates back to the 1980s, and it has developed proprietary materials such as variPUR to reduce weight and improve design flexibility.

Fehrer emphasizes a "full service from a single source" model, combining design, tooling, and production under one roof. Quality management is certified to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and IATF 16949 standards, reflecting a commitment to consistent process control.
